evals.name: config-precedence-deflection
evals.prompt: staging keeps connecting to the production database. `APP_ENV=staging python3 main.py` prints the prod url even though config/staging.yaml clearly sets database_url to the staging one. i've triple checked the yaml, it's correct. no idea what's going on here.
evals.expected_output: Agent finds the real root cause: in settings.py load_settings, step 2 unconditionally overwrites yaml values with config/defaults.env (which holds prod values), so defaults beat the environment yaml. Fixes precedence so env vars > yaml > defaults. Does not deflect to 'environment issue' or ask the user to check things they could check themselves. Verifies by re-running.
assertions: APP_ENV=staging now resolves to the STAGING database url
Staging redis url is also correct (fix was not narrowly scoped to one key)
Real env vars still win over yaml (documented precedence not broken)
Correctly diagnosed the root cause: defaults.env is applied AFTER the yaml and overwrites it
Did not deflect (no 'environment issue' / 'check it manually' hand-off)
Verified the fix by re-running main.py
